# ResearchPointRule

`world-system`

Points of research a player earns per source: a craft, a gathered resource, and a one-time bonus for the first craft of each recipe. Spent by beginResearch at the technology's researchCost.

> Make KnowledgeIsProgression cost something earned by play, not only materials and time

## Attributes

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| rules | json | Points per source { craft, gather, firstCraftOfRecipe } and caps { maxPoints, windowSeconds, windowCap }, non-negative integers (validated at fabric load) |
| maxResearchCost | integer | Upper bound a technology researchCost may take (validated at fabric load) |

## Actions

### grantPoints

Host-side grant of research points to the player who crafted or gathered

**Conditions:**
- Granted only by the host; a client's own grant call changes nothing
